title: Apply to pay voluntary National Insurance contributions for periods abroad by post (CF83)
text:
Check how to apply

 There are different ways to apply, depending on your circumstances.

 Find out  how to apply to pay voluntary National Insurance contributions if you’ve worked or lived abroad .

 If you cannot apply online

 • 
 Check which form you need.

 • 
 Print the relevant form.

 • 
 Fill it in.

 • 
 Post it to HMRC using the address on the form.

 Printable forms

 Application to pay voluntary National Insurance contributions abroad (CF83) 

 PDF , 305 KB , 4 pages 

 This file may not be suitable for users of assistive technology.

 Request an accessible format

 If you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader) and need a version of this document in a more accessible format, please email different.format@hmrc.gov.uk . Please tell us what format you need. It will help us if you say what assistive technology you use.

 Instruction to your bank or building society to pay by Direct Debit 

 PDF , 268 KB , 1 page 

 This file may not be suitable for users of assistive technology.

 Request an accessible format

 If you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader) and need a version of this document in a more accessible format, please email different.format@hmrc.gov.uk . Please tell us what format you need. It will help us if you say what assistive technology you use.

 If HMRC has written to you about paying voluntary Class 3 contributions

 If HMRC has written to you about paying voluntary Class 3 National Insurance contributions for periods abroad, do not use the forms on this page.

 Follow the instructions in your letter and apply to pay voluntary Class 3 National Insurance contributions for periods abroad .

 What happens next

 HMRC may contact you to ask for further information about your application.

 If your application is approved, HMRC will send an acceptance letter that includes:

 • how much you need to pay

 • when you need to pay it

 • your payment reference number

 Find out  when you can expect to receive a reply  from HMRC.

 You can  contact HMRC National Insurance enquiries  if you have further questions about paying National Insurance contributions and living abroad.
